headline: Mooring County Erupts as Violent Northern Front Engagements Intensify
war_summary: Operational momentum has shifted sharply into Mooring County over the latest hours, where furious assaults around Gravekeeper's Holdfast and Wiccwalk have produced six base transfers and over seventeen hundred casualties in the past two hours alone. Weathered Expanse remains intensely contested, yielding two fresh base transitions and more than one thousand combined casualties across the same span amid ongoing battles near Wightwalk and Frostmarch. By contrast, structural shifts have paused across Nevish Line despite sustained fighting that claimed over seven hundred casualties in two hours, leaving the sector split between five Warden and three Colonial holdings. Other previously volatile fronts have settled into relative lull: Palantine Berm, Kuura Strand, and Callahan's Passage recorded no base events over the last two hours, while Stlican Shelf registered moderate attrition without altering ownership lines. Across the theater, combat has concentrated heavily into northern strongpoints as both sides press contested borders.
